note: Apple's new HomeView and the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K both launch today.

front.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
front.tldr: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its newest AI model, to Search worldwide, promising clearer, more visual answers to complicated questions.

front.title: HomeView Launch Kicks Off as First Orders Reach Customers
front.tldr: Apple's new home device, HomeView, announced a month ago, began reaching customers today as the global rollout started in Australia and New Zealand.

front.title: Saoirse Ronan's first short film, Paper Plane, earns Oscar-qualifying status
front.tldr: Saoirse Ronan's directorial debut short, Paper Plane, won Best Narrative Short at the Austin Film Festival and earned Oscar-qualifying status, her first produced work behind the camera.

stories.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
stories.tldr: Amplitude's AI product agent, Wave, now spots what to build, ships changes with coding agents, and measures the result, cutting its improvement cycle to one or two days.

stories.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
stories.tldr: Gondola, which helps creatives get credit and get hired, has doubled revenue after Codex raised its lead engineer's output by 50 percent.

stories.title: Supporting research on AI and children's safety
stories.tldr: OpenAI is putting $2 million into research on AI and children's safety, funding shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

stories.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses, if you pay
stories.tldr: Meta's Muse assistant can now call US businesses on your behalf, such as to book a table, but only for paying subscribers.

stories.title: Whoop just launched a social network
stories.tldr: Whoop has launched a social network letting members share sleep, recovery and workout data, part of a bigger push to become a personal health brand rather than just a wearable.

stories.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
stories.tldr: Rather than another manual editing tool, Phota Labs automates the process entirely, so anyone can turn ordinary pictures into something better without learning new software.

stories.title: Hands-on with the first Android XR smartglasses
stories.tldr: Hands-on time with Google's first Android XR smartglasses left our reviewer rethinking the case for glasses without a display, calling the hardware surprisingly capable.

stories.title: Hands-On With the New Apple TV 4K and Siri AI
stories.tldr: The fourth-generation Apple TV 4K, with an A19 chip and Siri AI, goes on sale today. MacRumors got hands-on time with it ahead of launch.

stories.title: Apple HomeView Review Roundup: Simple, Charming, and Built for Apple Users
stories.tldr: The first wave of HomeView reviews is positive overall, with reviewers agreeing it suits people already using other Apple products best.

stories.title: Apple Explains How HomeView Keeps Camera Data Private
stories.tldr: Apple has detailed how Secure Exclaves isolate and protect camera and microphone data on HomeView, iPhone 18 Pro and other devices.

stories.title: Laika's 'Wildwood' Passes $60 Million Worldwide
stories.tldr: Laika's stop-motion film Wildwood has passed $60 million worldwide, recovering from a slow start to reach $41.86 million domestically.

stories.title: Brad Pitt to Star in 'Connector' from 'Sound of Metal' Director Darius Marder for Apple
stories.tldr: Apple has lined up Brad Pitt for Darius Marder's follow-up to Sound of Metal, playing a New York ironworker who becomes a working-class legend.

stories.title: 'The Good Daughter' Review: Rose Byrne Leads Peacock's Crime Drama
stories.tldr: Rose Byrne leads Peacock's six-episode adaptation of Karin Slaughter's The Good Daughter, about long-separated sisters reunited to defend a family member. The review calls the clichés thick, the cast sharp.

stories.title: Celtics win 5th straight, overcoming 22-point deficit to beat Raptors 98-93
stories.tldr: The Celtics erased a 22-point deficit to beat the Raptors 98-93, their fifth straight win. Jayson Tatum scored 24, Derrick White 19, Payton Pritchard 14.

stories.title: Paul George was the star of the Celtics' dominant win over the 76ers
stories.tldr: Paul George led Boston's dominant win over Philadelphia, needing no tribute video to make his return to the arena memorable.

stories.title: Patriots get pleasant surprise regarding Rhamondre Stevenson's injury status
stories.tldr: Rhamondre Stevenson returned to Patriots practice on Thursday, sooner than the several weeks he was reportedly expected to miss with a knee injury.

stories.title: 3 to Watch: Patriots and Lions Clash in Germany
stories.tldr: The Patriots play the Lions in Munich on Sunday, looking to get back on track after a heavy loss to Green Bay last week.

stories.title: Racing Bulls confirm 2027 line-up
stories.tldr: Racing Bulls have confirmed Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad will stay together for a second season in 2027, ending speculation about Lawson's seat.

stories.title: George Russell launches karting academy
stories.tldr: George Russell has launched a karting academy with Silverstone, aiming to make motorsport more accessible and find the sport's next young talent.

stories.title: Stats: Verstappen claims second place from lowest grid position since 1983
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen's charge to second in Brazil came from the lowest grid slot of any podium finisher since 1983, in a race that also had F1's first home debutant in almost 20 years.

stories.title: Gray, Contreras earn All-MLB honors after helping fuel Red Sox's turnaround
stories.tldr: Sonny Gray and Willson Contreras have been named to the All-MLB team, honours that reflect their part in the Red Sox's turnaround season.
